minimal_safe_implementation_note: No repository-wide conversion from global RNGs to Generator objects is attempted. Only components that ALREADY own an independent Generator/RandomState are seeded explicitly.

A repository-wide grep for wp.rand*, mjx random and mujoco seeding found no stochastic MuJoCo or Warp draw on this path. Physics is deterministic given the model, the initial state and the action sequence, for a fixed mujoco==3.5.0 / warp-lang==1.11.1 build. Determinism is therefore claimed only for the recorded runtime.
